patch.summary: GitHub cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: GitHub pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.heading: GitHub cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price GitHub against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (developer AI assistance (Free, Team, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (log management, source control and repos, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Copilot and Advanced Security are paid add-ons beyond Team/Enterprise seats. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Software teams needing Git source control as the system of record requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
